dct_description_sm:
Critical Infrastructure Facilities include features such as: Coast Guard, Ferry, Fire Halls, Police Station, Heliports, Hospital, Seaports, Water Airports, and Government Buildings.  This layer was part of the 2012 Official Community Plan (OCP).

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
